title: fss.fusion_eprocess_transcript.v1
description: Additive immutable commitment to one hypothesis-bound sequential fusion transition. The historical numerical v1 step digest is preserved; this transcript independently binds complete bounded state, the actual validated fusion query and decision or an exact reset-input digest, the canonical supporting-domain inventory and the previous transcript. Resetting the numerical regime never erases transcript ancestry. Replaying the exact ordered queries/resets reconstructs the digest. This proves neither source custody nor statistical independence, test-supermartingale validity, calibration qualification or effect authority.

previous_transcript_digest.description: Null only before the first accepted transition. Observations and resets both advance this chain.

numerical_step_digest.description: Unchanged historical fss.fusion.eprocess_step.v1 digest. Its original text limits remain; the separate state_digest preserves complete binding when legacy encoding exceeds those limits. Alone it is not an evidence receipt.

state_digest.description: fss.fusion.eprocess_state.v1 commitment to exact hypothesis bytes, configuration, step/regime, full numerical state and optional exact last-reset digest. All variable text is hashed to fixed-size fields, independently of historical v1 text limits.

supporting_domains_digest.description: fss.fusion.eprocess_support.v1 commitment to the complete lexicographically ordered failure-domain components after this transition. Constant-size tagged folds bind component boundaries and exact UTF-8 domain hashes.
